title: Spectral Stage Lighting Director
description: A rigged figure stands on a dark stage illuminated by a barn lamp. The user acts as a lighting director, layering and adjusting post-processing effects (bloom, color grading, vignette, chromatic aberration, film grain) to craft a dramatic scene. A total energy budget constrains all effects: boosting one forces others to decrease, and full undo/redo history tracks every change.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with the postprocessing pipeline from three/examples/jsm. Load AnisotropyBarnLamp.glb and place it stage-left pointing toward center. Load RiggedFigure.glb, scale it to roughly human height, and place it center-stage facing the camera. Use a PerspectiveCamera at moderate distance, slightly elevated, with OrbitControls limited to a 120-degree horizontal arc. Add a dim ambient light and a SpotLight parented to the barn lamp's emissive head so the lamp visually appears to cast light on the figure. Build an EffectComposer with five toggleable passes: UnrealBloomPass, a ShaderPass for color grading (exposure, saturation, hue-shift uniforms), a ShaderPass for vignette (darkness and offset uniforms), a ShaderPass for chromatic aberration (offset uniform), and a FilmPass for grain. Implement a conservation-law energy budget of 100 units. Each effect has an intensity slider 0-20. The sum of all five intensities must equal or stay below 100. When the user raises one slider and the total would exceed 100, proportionally reduce the other active sliders to compensate, keeping ratios intact. Display the remaining budget as a glowing bar at the top of the screen. Provide a UI panel on the right with sliders for each effect plus a master toggle per effect. Every slider change or toggle is recorded in an undo/redo stack (minimum 30 entries). Bind Ctrl+Z for undo and Ctrl+Shift+Z for redo, and also show undo/redo buttons in the panel. When an effect is toggled off, its energy returns to the budget but its slider value is preserved grayed-out. Animate the RiggedFigure with a subtle idle sway using its skeleton. The barn lamp should have a slow pulsing emissive glow synced to bloom intensity. Render at device pixel ratio capped at 2. The page background should be black. All UI text should use a monospace font with semi-transparent dark backgrounds for readability.
